messages:
jordan_cust: Hey support — after our IdP SAML cleanup we can no longer create new API keys in the Console. Click 'Create API Key' -> instant 403: "permission denied: missing roles". Old keys still work. Screenshot: https://redwood-support.s3.amazonaws.com/attachments/obs-2026/saml-attr.png

marta: sorry about that, sending to identity team. Can you paste your org id and the email you used to sign in? Also does this block all admins or just you?

jordan_cust: Org: org_12345, email jordan@acme.com. Tried with two org admins and they get the same 403 when creating a key.

alex: pinging @sam_identity — sounds like an attribute/claim mapping got changed during the IdP cleanup (groups/roles trimming).

sam_identity: grabbing logs for org_12345. Can you paste a redacted SAML assertion or a screenshot of the Attributes section? Also give me the internal user id if you have it (acct_789 or similar).

jordan_cust: attached a screenshot of Attributes (see link above). User id is acct_789.

sam_identity: thanks. I queried the authz resolver for acct_789:
```
$ curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <support-token>" "https://admin.redwood.internal/authz?user_id=acct_789" | jq .
{
  "user_id": "acct_789",
  "bindings": []  # no org role bindings returned
}
```
This matches the 403. The SAML assertion shows an attribute named `role` (singular) instead of the expected `roles` array. The IdP cleanup collapsed the group/role claim into a single token named `role`. Our parser only looked for `roles` and `groups` previously.

marta: ok so the platform didn't get any role bindings during signin. What's a short-term fix?

sam_identity: quick workaround: I created a temporary org role-binding for acct_789 -> org.admin via the admin panel so you can create keys while we patch. Command used (internal):
```
POST https://admin.redwood.internal/orgs/org_12345/bindings
Body: { "user_id": "acct_789", "role": "org.admin" }
```
That will persist until you revoke it.

alex: i'll coordinate the code fix. We should accept both `role` and `roles` and coerce singleton strings into a list during mapping. I'll open a PR and deploy a small patch.

sam_identity: deployed a hotfix to identity-mapper (v1.5.4) and triggered a resync for org_12345. Deploy log: deploy-bot: identity-mapper v1.5.4 rolled out to staging then prod :rocket: (change includes fallback mapping for `role` -> `[role]`).

deploy-bot: identity-mapper v1.5.4 deployed to prod for mapping-fallback.

sam_identity: resync complete. Jordan, can you try creating an API key now?

jordan_cust: Tried now — success! New key created and shows in Console. Thanks all :tada:

marta: glad that's fixed. We'll follow up with your IdP admins to update the assertion name, but the platform is now resilient to that variant. I'll keep this thread open until the postmortem doc is posted. :thumbsup:
